name: Localization Exclusions
query:
select
	te.locale as "Locale:Link/Locale Profile:90",
	te.app as "App::140",
	coalesce(nullif(te.na_reason, ''), 'No reason recorded') as "Reason::170",
	coalesce(nullif(te.na_rule, ''), '') as "Rule::150",
	count(*) as "Strings:Int:80",
	min(te.source_text) as "Example::300"
from `tabTranslation Entry` te
where te.status = 'Not Applicable'
group by te.locale, te.app, coalesce(nullif(te.na_reason, ''), 'No reason recorded'), coalesce(nullif(te.na_rule, ''), '')
order by te.locale asc, count(*) desc, te.app asc
